title: Mixed Duo #10
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Hawaiian, in her mid 50s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in sharply even at this size — but projecting forward prominently from that waistline, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest,, every other curve of her oversized at once around it: enormous round hips flaring out more than three times the waistline's width, gigantic soft thighs. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a natural glowing complexion, a flower tucked behind one ear, warm golden-tan skin, low bun hair, real pores, real living eyes, 3 a mix of hoops, studs and drops piercings set with amethysts in copper-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of platinum earrings. Painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel, a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing frontal, both hands cradling the underside of her belly, chin level, calm commanding presence, extreme gold extreme platform buckled boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Uzbek, in her late 40s, cheerful expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an enormous, overwhelmingly muscular woman. Massive thick arms with heavy defined muscle, a broad powerful muscular back, a huge powerful chest, a heavy dense muscular torso and legs, only a soft hint of a waistline. Enormous round hips and colossal thick thighs with muscle visible through a soft layer, thick heavy calves. Not slim, not lean. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, a jewelled brow ornament, deep red lips, warm olive skin, a regal composed expression, curly hair, real pores, real living eyes, 5 hoops piercings set with opals in copper-toned metal, wearing two to three pieces of silver a necklace. Painted in Ethiopian cross-and-lattice gold pattern, a deep wine-red ground with fine gold lattice linework, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on one knee, the other raised, hands resting on her thigh, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
